description: This file defines the ChooseBlockController class for Drupal's layout builder module, providing UI and logic for selecting and adding blocks within layout sections, including inline blocks and categorization.

classes.name: ChooseBlockController
classes.description: Controller class for managing block selection UI in Drupal's layout builder, implementing container injection, and providing methods for building block selection interfaces and inline block lists.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting block manager, entity type manager, and current user services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the controller with services from the container.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for choosing a new block, including inline block creation and category-based block listing.

methods.name: inlineBlockList
methods.description: Provides UI for listing inline blocks available for a section.

methods.name: getBlockLinks
methods.description: Generates render array of links for each block, used in block selection interfaces.

methods.name: getAjaxAttributes
methods.description: Returns dialog-related attributes if the request is via AJAX.
